title: Taiwan's Top Research Institute Renews Science Partnership With France
summaryZh: 中研院與法國CNRS續約，合作延至2030年
summaryHi: एकेडेमिया सिनिका और फ्रांस के CNRS ने वैज्ञानिक साझेदारी 2030 तक बढ़ाई।
summaryEs: Academia Sinica y el CNRS francés renuevan su alianza científica hasta 2030.
summaryJa: 中央研究院と仏CNRS、研究協力を2030年まで延長。
summaryKo: 대만 중앙연구원과 프랑스 CNRS, 과학 협력 2030년까지 연장.
summaryEn: Academia Sinica and France's CNRS extend their science partnership to 2030.
paragraphs: Academia Sinica, Taiwan's foremost research institution, has renewed its scientific partnership with France's National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS), extending a relationship that began in 2018 until at least 2030. The agreement, first renewed in 2022, also raises the possibility of an international research laboratory being set up at Academia Sinica.

Academia Sinica president Chen Chien-jen signed the memorandum of understanding with French representatives. He and CNRS chairman and chief executive Thierry Dauxois had laid the groundwork for the deal when they met at this year's Science and Technology in Society forum in Kyoto.

The two bodies already cooperate through researcher exchanges, joint projects and educational programs designed to train specialists. Their shared work ranges from ion channels in nerve cells and topological materials to the analysis of protein structures, as well as collaboration in the humanities.

The new memorandum focuses on regularly scheduled academic seminars, research grants and mechanisms that support joint and interdisciplinary research. Ocean sciences, biobanks, quantum physics and biofuels were named as future areas of cooperation, fields described as vital for tackling global scientific and social challenges.

According to CNRS, international research laboratories are a key tool for global collaboration because they pool researchers, expertise and resources from partner institutions. A lab at Academia Sinica would give the two sides a long-term platform for bilateral cooperation.

Academia Sinica is the most important research center in Taiwan. CNRS is a big science group in France. The two groups have worked together since 2018. Now they want to keep working together until 2030.
The president of Academia Sinica, Chen Chien-jen, signed a new agreement. Thierry Dauxois is the head of CNRS. The two men met earlier this year at a meeting in Kyoto, Japan.
Scientists from both groups already do research together. They study nerve cells, new materials and proteins. They also work on history and culture.
In the future, they want to study the ocean, quantum physics and new kinds of fuel. They will have regular meetings and give money for research.
They may also build a shared lab at Academia Sinica. This lab could help Taiwan and France work together for a long time.

他們研究神經細胞、新材料和蛋白質。

未來，他們想研究海洋、量子物理和新種類的燃料。

paragraphs: Academia Sinica, Taiwan's leading research institute, has agreed to continue its scientific partnership with France's National Centre for Scientific Research, known as CNRS. The two first signed an agreement in 2018 and renewed it in 2022. The new deal extends their work together until 2030.

Academia Sinica president Chen Chien-jen signed the memorandum of understanding with French representatives. Chen and CNRS chief executive Thierry Dauxois had met earlier at the Science and Technology in Society forum in Kyoto, Japan, to prepare for the agreement.

The two institutes already share researchers and run joint projects and training programs. Their studies cover ion channels in nerve cells, special materials called topological materials, and the structure of proteins. They also work together on the humanities.

Under the new agreement, they will hold regular seminars, offer research grants and create ways for scientists from different fields to work together. They plan to explore ocean science, biobanks, quantum physics and biofuels.
The deal could also lead to an international research laboratory at Academia Sinica. CNRS says such labs bring together people, knowledge and resources from partner institutions.
sentZh: 台灣頂尖的研究機構中央研究院，同意繼續與法國國家科學研究中心（簡稱CNRS）的科學合作。
雙方在2018年第一次簽約，並在2022年續約。
新的協議把他們的合作延長到2030年。
中研院院長陳建仁和法國代表簽署了這份合作備忘錄。
陳建仁和CNRS執行長杜科瓦先前在日本京都的「科學技術與人類未來國際論壇」見面，為這份協議做準備。
兩個機構已經互相交流研究人員，並進行共同計畫和培訓課程。
他們的研究包括神經細胞的離子通道、一種叫做拓樸材料的特殊材料，以及蛋白質的結構。
他們也在人文學科方面合作。
根據新協議，他們會定期舉辦研討會、提供研究補助，並建立讓不同領域科學家一起工作的方式。
他們計畫探索海洋科學、生物資料庫、量子物理和生質燃料。
這項協議也可能促成在中研院設立一間國際研究實驗室。
CNRS說，這類實驗室能把合作機構的人才、知識和資源集合在一起。

paragraphs: Academia Sinica, Taiwan's foremost research institution, has renewed its scientific partnership with France's National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS), extending a relationship that began in 2018 until at least 2030. The agreement, first renewed in 2022, also raises the possibility of an international research laboratory being set up at Academia Sinica.

Academia Sinica president Chen Chien-jen signed the memorandum of understanding with French representatives. He and CNRS chairman and chief executive Thierry Dauxois had laid the groundwork for the deal when they met at this year's Science and Technology in Society forum in Kyoto.

The two bodies already cooperate through researcher exchanges, joint projects and educational programs designed to train specialists. Their shared work ranges from ion channels in nerve cells and topological materials to the analysis of protein structures, as well as collaboration in the humanities.

The new memorandum focuses on regularly scheduled academic seminars, research grants and mechanisms that support joint and interdisciplinary research. Ocean sciences, biobanks, quantum physics and biofuels were named as future areas of cooperation, fields described as vital for tackling global scientific and social challenges.

According to CNRS, international research laboratories are a key tool for global collaboration because they pool researchers, expertise and resources from partner institutions. A lab at Academia Sinica would give the two sides a long-term platform for bilateral cooperation.
sentZh: 台灣首屈一指的研究機構中央研究院，已與法國國家科學研究中心（CNRS）續簽科學合作，讓這段始於2018年的關係至少延續到2030年。
這份在2022年首度續約的協議，也帶來在中研院設立國際研究實驗室的可能性。
中研院院長陳建仁與法國代表簽署了這份合作備忘錄。
他和CNRS董事長兼執行長杜科瓦今年在京都的「科學技術與人類未來國際論壇」會面時，就為這項協議打下了基礎。
這兩個機構已經透過研究人員交流、共同計畫，以及培養專業人才的教育課程進行合作。
他們共同的研究範圍從神經細胞的離子通道、拓樸材料到蛋白質結構分析，還包括人文領域的合作。
新的備忘錄著重於定期舉辦的學術研討會、研究補助，以及支持共同研究與跨領域研究的機制。
海洋科學、生物資料庫、量子物理和生質燃料被列為未來的合作領域，這些領域被形容為因應全球科學與社會挑戰的關鍵。
根據CNRS的說法，國際研究實驗室是推動全球合作的重要工具，因為它們能匯集合作機構的研究人員、專業知識和資源。
在中研院設立實驗室，將為雙方提供一個長期的雙邊合作平台。

paragraphs: Taiwan's premier research body, Academia Sinica, has prolonged its alliance with France's National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS), securing scientific cooperation through to 2030. The memorandum of understanding builds on an accord first struck in 2018 and renewed in 2022, and it opens the door to an international research laboratory based at Academia Sinica.

The document was signed by Academia Sinica president Chen Chien-jen and French representatives, following groundwork laid when Chen met CNRS chairman and chief executive Thierry Dauxois at this year's Science and Technology in Society forum in Kyoto.

Existing ties are already substantial, encompassing personnel exchanges, collaborative projects and training schemes for specialists. Joint investigations span ion channels in nerve cells, topological materials and protein structure analysis, alongside partnerships in the humanities.

The renewed pact places emphasis on a regular programme of academic seminars, dedicated research grants and mechanisms to foster interdisciplinary work. Looking ahead, the partners have singled out ocean sciences, biobanks, quantum physics and biofuels as priorities, describing them as pivotal to addressing pressing global and societal challenges.

CNRS regards international research laboratories as an essential instrument for advancing cooperation, since they consolidate researchers, know-how and resources from the institutions involved. Should one be established in Taipei, it would provide an enduring platform for Franco-Taiwanese science.
sentZh: 台灣最高研究機構中央研究院延長了與法國國家科學研究中心（CNRS）的合作聯盟，確保雙方的科學合作一直持續到2030年。
這份合作備忘錄建立在2018年首次達成、2022年續約的協議之上，並為在中研院設立國際研究實驗室開啟了大門。
這份文件由中研院院長陳建仁和法國代表簽署，而基礎早在陳建仁今年於京都「科學技術與人類未來國際論壇」與CNRS董事長兼執行長杜科瓦會面時就已奠定。
雙方現有的關係已相當深厚，涵蓋人員交流、合作計畫和專業人才培訓方案。
共同研究橫跨神經細胞離子通道、拓樸材料和蛋白質結構分析，另外還有人文領域的合作。
續簽的協議著重於定期的學術研討會、專項研究補助，以及促進跨領域研究的機制。
展望未來，雙方特別挑出海洋科學、生物資料庫、量子物理和生質燃料作為優先項目，並形容它們是解決迫切全球與社會挑戰的關鍵。
CNRS認為國際研究實驗室是推動合作的重要工具，因為它們能整合參與機構的研究人員、技術知識與資源。
如果在台北設立這樣的實驗室，將為法台科學合作提供一個長久的平台。

paragraphs: In a move underscoring the growing internationalisation of Taiwanese science, Academia Sinica has renewed its partnership with France's National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS), thereby guaranteeing bilateral collaboration until 2030. Originally concluded in 2018 and subsequently extended in 2022, the arrangement now also contemplates the establishment of an international research laboratory on Academia Sinica's campus.

The memorandum of understanding was signed by Academia Sinica president Chen Chien-jen and French representatives, the foundations having been laid during a meeting between Chen and CNRS chairman and chief executive Thierry Dauxois at this year's Science and Technology in Society forum in Kyoto.

The institutions already maintain extensive links, including researcher exchanges, joint projects and educational initiatives intended to cultivate specialist expertise. Their collaborative inquiries encompass ion channels in nerve cells, topological materials and the analysis of protein structures, in addition to cooperation within the humanities.

Under the revised framework, priority will be given to regularly scheduled academic seminars, competitive research grants and mechanisms that facilitate interdisciplinary investigation. Ocean sciences, biobanks, quantum physics and biofuels have been identified as prospective domains of cooperation, all of which are regarded as instrumental in confronting the scientific and societal challenges facing humanity.

CNRS characterises international research laboratories as a cornerstone of global collaboration, given their capacity to pool personnel, expertise and resources from participating institutions. Were such a facility to materialise, it would furnish both sides with a durable platform for sustained scientific engagement.
sentZh: 中央研究院與法國國家科學研究中心（CNRS）續簽合作關係，確保雙邊合作持續到2030年，這項舉動突顯了台灣科學日益國際化。
這項安排最初於2018年締結，隨後在2022年延長，如今也考慮在中研院院區內設立一間國際研究實驗室。
這份合作備忘錄由中研院院長陳建仁與法國代表簽署，其基礎是在今年京都「科學技術與人類未來國際論壇」上，陳建仁與CNRS董事長兼執行長杜科瓦會面時奠定的。
兩個機構已維持廣泛的聯繫，包括研究人員交流、共同計畫，以及旨在培養專業知識的教育方案。
他們的合作研究涵蓋神經細胞的離子通道、拓樸材料和蛋白質結構分析，此外還有人文領域內的合作。
在修訂後的框架下，將優先推動定期舉辦的學術研討會、競爭型研究補助，以及促進跨領域研究的機制。
海洋科學、生物資料庫、量子物理和生質燃料被認定為未來可能的合作領域，這些領域都被視為因應人類所面臨科學與社會挑戰的關鍵。
CNRS將國際研究實驗室形容為全球合作的基石，因為它們能匯集參與機構的人員、專業知識和資源。
如果這樣的設施得以實現，將為雙方提供一個持久的平台，以維持長期的科學交流。
